package fixture

import (
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/codegen"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/schema/ir"
)

var _ func(string, ir.Schema) ([]byte, error) = codegen.GenerateRelationMetadata
var _ func(string, []codegen.BridgePackage) ([]byte, error) = codegen.GenerateProjectBridge
var _ func(...ir.Schema) (orm.ProjectBinding, error) = orm.BindProject

func relationPublicSurface() {
	source := ir.ModelIdentity{AppLabel: "blog", ModelName: "post"}
	target := ir.ModelIdentity{AppLabel: "authors", ModelName: "author"}
	forward := orm.RelationMetadata{
		Source:      source,
		Field:       "author",
		Column:      "author_id",
		Target:      target,
		Nullable:    false,
		Cardinality: ir.RelationManyToOne,
		Reverse:     ir.ReverseRelation{Name: "posts"},
		OnDelete:    ir.DeleteProtect,
	}
	reverse := orm.ReverseRelationMetadata{
		Owner:       target,
		Name:        "posts",
		Target:      source,
		SourceField: "author",
		Cardinality: ir.RelationOneToMany,
	}
	bindError := &orm.RelationBindingError{
		Code:        orm.RelationBindingReverseNameCollision,
		AppLabel:    "blog",
		ModelName:   "post",
		FieldName:   "author",
		Target:      target,
		ReverseName: "posts",
	}
	var _ error = bindError
	_ = orm.RelationBindingDuplicateApp
	_ = orm.RelationBindingUnresolvedTarget
	_ = forward
	_ = reverse

	project, _ := orm.BindProject()
	_ = project.ForwardRelations()
	_ = project.ReverseRelations()
	_, _ = project.Relation(source, "author")

	_, _ = codegen.GenerateProjectBridge("binding", []codegen.BridgePackage{{
		Alias:      "authors",
		ImportPath: "example.com/project/authors",
	}})
}
